text: APPROVE. The if/else-if/else block moves into `CompareSegment` unchanged. The mixed case still returns a nonzero -1 or 1 that the caller's `c != 0` check returns immediately, as the old early return did. The removed branching brings the method under the threshold, and the new private static method should not trip any build warnings. I couldn't see the declared element type of `left` and `right`, so I assumed non-nullable `object`; a nullable element type could raise a nullable warning, which would break a warnings-as-errors build.
